settings.description: Temperature control accuracy. The range is -0.2 ~ -1°C, with an interval of 0.2, and the default is -1. If -0.4°C is chosen as the temperature control accuracy, then the valve will close when the room temperature reaches 26 degrees and open at 25.6 degrees.
